description: This Java class `DefaultAcknowledgementConfig` provides a default implementation for the `AcknowledgementConfig` interface, encapsulating configuration parameters related to acknowledgement behavior, such as fallback timeouts, lifetimes, and maximum issued bytes. It includes static methods to create instances from `Config` objects, getters for configuration fields, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultAcknowledgementConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing the `AcknowledgementConfig` interface, providing configuration parameters for acknowledgement handling with methods to instantiate from a `Config` object and override default `Object` methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of `DefaultAcknowledgementConfig` from a given Typesafe `Config` object, utilizing fallback configuration.

methods.name: getForwarderFallbackTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for forwarder fallback timeout.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackLifetime
methods.description: Returns the duration for collector fallback lifetime.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for collector fallback ask timeout.

methods.name: getIssuedMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes issued.
